title: Protect tool webhooks with per-call tokens
summary: Every tool webhook needs a token minted for that call and function. Another call, another function, an edit or expiry gets a refusal, and so does no token at all.
scenario: An account line where refunds must not be triggered from outside the call that asked

evidence: sdk security/session_manager.py:55-91 HMAC over call_id:function:expiry:nonce; validate_token checks function, expiry, signature, call_id
sdk agent_base.py:931-936 __token appended to web_hook_url for secure functions when call_id is known
sdk web_mixin.py:768 basic auth first; :862-882 token checked only when present
